The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land…
All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

translations.web: they were very afraid, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
translations.bsb: So Adoni-zedek and his people were greatly alarmed, because Gibeon was a great city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were mighty.
translations.kjv: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
translations.asv: that they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
